'''Zombie pirates''' are encountered during [[Rum Deal]] on [[Braindeath Island]] (level 50) and during [[Pieces of Hate]] on [[Mos Le'Harmless]] (Level 35). They are aggressive. These are one of the only creatures to regularly drop [[bandana and eyepatch]]es.
